title: Услуга аутсорсинга по доставке еды ШТЁ

criteria.label: Таъминотчи Корхонанинг Балансида ошхонаси мавжудлиги ҳамда масофаси (Беморларга хизмат курсатиш сифатли бўлиш мақсадида Денов ТТБ Бирлашмасига яқин корхонага авзалик берилади )

subject_uz: Tibbiyot birlashmasi bemorlari uchun uch mahal issiq ovqat tayyorlash va yetkazish xizmati

requirements.summary_uz: Tayyorlangan ovqatlar Sog'liqni saqlash vazirligining tasdiqlangan me'yorlariga mos kelishi shart.
requirements.summary_en: Prepared meals must meet the Ministry of Health approved norms.
requirements.quote: Тайёрланган овкатларлар ССВнинг тасдикданган меъёларига мос келиши шарт

requirements.summary_uz: Ovqatni malakali oshpazlar gigiena qoidalariga rioya qilib tayyorlashi, kaloriyasi me'yorga mos bo'lishi kerak.
requirements.summary_en: Meals must be cooked by qualified cooks under hygiene rules, with calories matching the norm.
requirements.quote: озик-овкат махсулотларини малака ва куникмага эга булган ошпазлар томонидан гигеник коидаларга риоя килган холда таёрланиши керак

requirements.summary_uz: Eng ko'p ball (30) ta'minotchining o'z balansida oshxonasi bo'lishi va birlashmaga yaqinligi uchun beriladi.
requirements.summary_en: The largest score (30 points) goes to having a kitchen on the supplier's own balance sheet and proximity to the hospital.
requirements.quote: Балансида ошхонаси мавжудлиги ҳамда масофаси (Беморларга хизмат курсатиш сифатли бўлиш мақсадида Денов ТТБ Бирлашмасига яқин корхонага авзалик берилади

requirements.summary_uz: Kafolat xati 5 ball: nuqson va kamchiliklar qisqa muddatda bartaraf etilishi kafolatlanadi.
requirements.summary_en: Guarantee letter worth 5 points: defects must be remedied quickly at the customer's request.
requirements.quote: уларни қисқа муддатда буюртмачи талабига асосан бартараф этилишини таъминлаш тўғрисида кафолат хати илова қилиниши шарт

requirements.summary_uz: Soliq va majburiy to'lovlar bo'yicha qarzdorlik yo'qligi ma'lumotnomasi 10 ball bilan baholanadi.
requirements.summary_en: Certificate of no tax or mandatory-payment debt is scored at 10 points.
requirements.quote: Солиқ ва бошқа мажбурий тўловлардан қарздорлиги йўқлиги тўғрисида маълумотнома илова қилиниши шарт

requirements.summary_uz: Umumiy ma'lumot (5 ball): ustav, guvohnoma, xodimlar, asbob-uskunalar, mahsulot sertifikatlari va oldingi buyurtmachilardan tavsiyanoma.
requirements.summary_en: General information (5 points): charter, registration, staff, equipment list, product certificates and references from past customers.
requirements.quote: Қайси ташкилотларда ишлаган бўлса уша ташкилотлардан тавсиянома.

requirements.summary_uz: Ishtirokchi davlat ro'yxatidan o'tganiga 6 oydan ko'p vaqt o'tgan bo'lishi shart.
requirements.summary_en: Participant must have been state-registered for more than 6 months.
requirements.quote: Бунда иштирокчининг давлат рўйхатидан ўтганига 6 ойдан кўп вақт ўтган бўлиши шарт.

requirements.summary_uz: Ishtirokchi bankrotlik, qayta tashkil etish yoki tugatish bosqichida emasligi haqida kafolat xati beradi.
requirements.summary_en: Guarantee letter that the participant is not in bankruptcy, reorganisation or liquidation.

requirements.summary_uz: Shartnoma imzolangandan keyin qiymatning 30 foizi 5 ish kunida avans sifatida to'lanadi, qolgani yakunda.
requirements.summary_en: 30% of the contract value is paid as an advance within 5 working days of signing; the rest on completion.
requirements.quote: шартнома кийматининг 30 % микдори 5 иш куни давомида тулаб берилади.

requirements.summary_uz: Xizmat hajmi 1800 birlikdan to'qqiz pozitsiya, yetkazish muddati 10 kun.
requirements.summary_en: Nine line items of 1800 units each, delivery term 10 days.
requirements.quote: Иштирокчилар куйидаги мезонларга жавоб бериши шарт

flags.quote: Балансида ошхонаси мавжудлиги ҳамда масофаси (Беморларга хизмат курсатиш сифатли бўлиш мақсадида Денов ТТБ Бирлашмасига яқин корхонага авзалик берилади
flags.explanation_uz: Ushbu mezon 30 ball beradi, ya'ni baholanadigan 50 ballning (30+5+10+5) 60 foizi, o'tish bali esa 20. O'z balansida oshxonasi bo'lmagan yoki birlashmadan uzoqroq joylashgan, lekin sifatli ovqatni yetkazib bera oladigan ta'minotchi bu ballarni deyarli ololmaydi. Xizmat sifati ovqat sifati va yetkazish muddati bilan ham tekshirilishi mumkin.
flags.explanation_en: This criterion carries 30 points, 60% of the 50 scorable points (30+5+10+5), against a pass mark of 20. A supplier that does not own a kitchen on its balance sheet, or is located farther away, but could still deliver good food on time, would score almost nothing on it. Service quality can also be checked through meal standards and delivery time.
flags.rewrite_uz: Ta'minotchi bemorlarga issiq ovqatni belgilangan vaqtda yetkazib bera olishini tasdiqlovchi hujjat (o'z yoki ijaradagi oshxona, transport, yetkazish jadvali) taqdim etadi; ball masofaga emas, yetkazish muddati va ovqat haroratini ta'minlash qobiliyatiga qarab beriladi.
flags.rewrite_en: The supplier provides evidence that it can deliver hot meals to patients on schedule (own or leased kitchen, transport, delivery schedule); points depend on ability to meet delivery times and serving temperature, not on distance or ownership.
flags.type_label_uz: Raqobatni cheklashi mumkin bo'lgan boshqa shart
flags.type_label_en: Other clause that may limit competition
flags.category_uz: Muayyan ishtirokchilar uchun ustunlik yaratish (Raqobat qo'mitasi tasnifi, 2025)
flags.category_en: Creation of advantages for specific bidders (Competition Committee category, 2025)

flags.quote: Бунда иштирокчининг давлат рўйхатидан ўтганига 6 ойдан кўп вақт ўтган бўлиши шарт.
flags.explanation_uz: Davlat ro'yxatidan o'tganiga 6 oydan kam bo'lgan korxona, hatto tajribali xodimlari va oshxonasi bo'lsa ham, shu mezon bo'yicha chetlashtirilishi mumkin. Talab oziq-ovqat xizmatining sifatiga bevosita bog'liq emas.
flags.explanation_en: A company registered less than 6 months ago may be excluded on this criterion even if it has experienced staff and a working kitchen. The requirement is not directly tied to the quality of a catering service.
flags.rewrite_uz: Ishtirokchining tegishli ovqat tayyorlash tajribasini (shartnomalar, xodimlar malakasi) tasdiqlovchi hujjatlar so'raladi; ro'yxatdan o'tish muddatiga cheklov qo'yilmaydi.
flags.rewrite_en: Ask for documents confirming relevant catering experience (contracts, staff qualifications) and do not set a minimum registration age.

reasons_uz: Hujjatda raqobatni jiddiy cheklashi mumkin bo'lgan bir nechta shart bor; ularga aniqlik kiritilmaguncha qatnashish tavsiya etilmaydi.

Raqobatni cheklashi mumkin bo'lgan boshqa shart (platformadagi mezonlar): Ushbu mezon 30 ball beradi, ya'ni baholanadigan 50 ballning (30+5+10+5) 60 foizi, o'tish bali esa 20. O'z balansida oshxonasi bo'lmagan yoki birlashmadan uzoqroq joylashgan, lekin sifatli ovqatni yetkazib bera oladigan ta'minotchi bu ballarni deyarli ololmaydi. Xizmat sifati ovqat sifati va yetkazish muddati bilan ham tekshirilishi mumkin.

Raqobatni cheklashi mumkin bo'lgan boshqa shart (platformadagi mezonlar): Davlat ro'yxatidan o'tganiga 6 oydan kam bo'lgan korxona, hatto tajribali xodimlari va oshxonasi bo'lsa ham, shu mezon bo'yicha chetlashtirilishi mumkin. Talab oziq-ovqat xizmatining sifatiga bevosita bog'liq emas.
Buyurtmachining so'nggi 21 ta savdosida ishtirokchilar medianasi 2 ta; savdolarning 86% qismida ikki yoki undan kam ishtirokchi; eng ko'p g'olib bo'lgan yetkazib beruvchi ulushi 52%.
Diqqat: hujjatning 3 ta sahifasi mashina o'qiy olmaydigan skan, ular tahlil qilinmadi.
reasons_en: The document holds several conditions that may seriously limit competition; bidding is not advised until they are clarified.

Other clause that may limit competition (platform criteria form): This criterion carries 30 points, 60% of the 50 scorable points (30+5+10+5), against a pass mark of 20. A supplier that does not own a kitchen on its balance sheet, or is located farther away, but could still deliver good food on time, would score almost nothing on it. Service quality can also be checked through meal standards and delivery time.

Other clause that may limit competition (platform criteria form): A company registered less than 6 months ago may be excluded on this criterion even if it has experienced staff and a working kitchen. The requirement is not directly tied to the quality of a catering service.
In the customer's last 21 deals the median number of bidders was 2; 86% of deals had two or fewer bidders; the most frequent winner took 52%.
Note: 3 page(s) of the document are scans without readable text and were not analysed.
